content_sections.heading: RRC NR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can submit the RRC NR Apprentice online application form from 11 November to 11 December 2026. The merit list is expected to be displayed in February 2027.

content_sections.heading: RRC NR Apprentice Vacancy 2026 – Cluster-Wise Details
content_sections.text: Northern Railway has announced 4,651 Act Apprentice training slots across six clusters. Candidates can check the cluster-wise vacancy distribution below. Candidates must check the trade-wise and unit-wise training slots in Annexure-A of the official notification before selecting a cluster. Applications submitted for units where the candidate's ITI trade is not notified may be rejected.

content_sections.heading: RRC NR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Northern Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2026 must meet the educational qualification and age requirements specified in the notification. Must have passed Class 10 (Matriculation) or equivalent under the 10+2 examination system from a recognised board. Must have secured at least 50% aggregate marks in Class 10. Must possess an ITI qualification in the relevant trade recognised by NCVT/SCVT. Both Class 10 and ITI qualifications must have been completed on or before 06 November 2026. Note: Candidates awaiting their Class 10 or ITI results as of the notification date are not eligible to apply.

content_sections.heading: RRC NR Apprentice Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit for RRC NR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is calculated as on 11 December 2026. SC/ST: 5 Years OBC: 3 Years PwBD: 10 Years Ex-Servicemen: As per the conditions mentioned in the official notification

content_sections.heading: RRC NR Apprentice Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee must be paid online while submitting the RRC NR Apprentice application form. The application fee is non-refundable. Applicable online transaction charges, if any, must be paid by the candidate.

content_sections.heading: RRC NR Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection for RRC NR Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026 will be based on merit calculated from Class 10 and ITI marks. There will be no written examination or interview. Screening and scrutiny of online applications. Preparation of merit lists based on the average percentage of Class 10 and ITI marks, with equal weightage. Document verification of shortlisted candidates. Fulfilment of prescribed medical fitness requirements. Merit Calculation: (Class 10 Percentage + ITI Percentage) / 2 If two candidates receive the same merit score, preference will be given to the older candidate. If their dates of birth are also the same, the candidate who passed Matriculation earlier will be preferred.

content_sections.heading: RRC NR Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected apprentices will receive a stipend during their training according to the applicable Apprenticeship Rules. The official RRC NR notification does not specify a fixed monthly stipend amount for each trade. Apprenticeship training does not guarantee permanent employment in Northern Railway after completion of the training period.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for RRC NR Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply online for RRC NR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 through the official website before 11 December 2026. Visit the official Northern Railway RRC website at www.rrcnr.org . Find the Engagement of Act Apprentice 2026 online application link. Complete registration using your personal details, mobile number and email ID. Log in using the registration credentials. Enter the required personal, educational and ITI qualification details. Select the appropriate cluster and unit based on the available slots for your ITI trade. Upload the required photograph, signature, thumb impression and certificates. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review the details and submit the application form. Download and print the submitted application and fee receipt for future reference. Important: Only one application is permitted per candidate. Multiple applications may lead to rejection, and changes are not allowed after final submission.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RRC NR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 11 December 2026. Applications opened on 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in RRC NR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4651 vacancies: 1525 Act Apprentice - Cluster Lucknow (LKO), 1312 Act Apprentice - Cluster Delhi (DLI), 740 Act Apprentice - Cluster Firozpur (FZR), 63 Act Apprentice - Cluster Moradabad (MB), 979 Act Apprentice - Cluster Ambala (UMB), 32 Act Apprentice - Cluster Jammu.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for RRC NR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Others: Rs. 100 (non-refundable). SC/ST/PwBD/Women: No fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is should have completed 15 years of age and should not have completed 24 years of age (as on 11 December 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years, PwBD 10 years, Ex-Servicemen Up to additional 10 years to the extent of service rendered in Defence Forces plus 3 years, with minimum 6 months service at a stretch.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: As per extant rules applicable for Act Apprentice - Cluster Lucknow (LKO), As per extant rules applicable for Act Apprentice - Cluster Delhi (DLI), As per extant rules applicable for Act Apprentice - Cluster Firozpur (FZR), As per extant rules applicable for Act Apprentice - Cluster Moradabad (MB), As per extant rules applicable for Act Apprentice - Cluster Ambala (UMB).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 10th class (10+2 system) with minimum 50% marks in aggregate from a recognised Board, and ITI in the relevant trade (NCVT/SCVT), passed by 06/11/2026. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must meet physical fitness standards under the Apprentices Act 1961 and Apprenticeship Rules 1992. PwBD candidates must apply against slots notified for their type of disability. Application must be filled in English or Hindi. Only one application per candidate; multiple applications are all rejected.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates whose 10th or ITI result is awaited on 06/11/2026. Candidates debarred for life by RRB/RRC, or debarred for a period not yet completed. Ex-servicemen who already joined Govt. civil service after availing ex-servicemen status (for age relaxation).

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening and scrutiny of applications. Merit list from average of 10th and ITI percentage marks with equal weightage. Document Verification with medical certificate. No written test or viva.
